## Use Oxygen Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Oxygen Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Oxygen Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Oxygen Mono coding font

The monospace font from the KDE project. Oxygen Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Oxygen Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Oxygen Mono FAQ

### Is Oxygen Mono free?

Yes. Oxygen Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Oxygen Mono support ligatures?

No. Oxygen Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Oxygen Mono?

Oxygen Mono is available from Google Fonts and KDE. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
